{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]+', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm the count and check for outliers
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()}")
print(f"Median revenue: {loyal_completed['revenue'].median()}")
print(f"Min revenue: {loyal_completed['revenue'].min()}")
print(f"Max revenue: {loyal_completed['revenue'].max()}")

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high or zero
print("\nTop 5 highest revenue values:")
print(loyal_completed.nlargest(5, 'revenue'))"}
